prompt: Docker mein localhost kaam kyun nahi karta?
title: Docker mein localhost kaam kyun nahi karta?

script.title: Docker mein localhost kaam kyun nahi karta?

dialogue.speaker: oggy
dialogue.text: Jack, mera Node app laptop pe chal raha tha, par Docker mein daala toh database se connect hi nahi hota. ECONNREFUSED aa raha hai!

dialogue.speaker: jack
dialogue.text: Kyunki tumne host localhost likha hai. Container ke andar localhost matlab woh container khud, na tumhara laptop, na database.

broll.code:
DB_HOST=localhost
# inside the app container,
# localhost = the app itself

dialogue.speaker: oggy
dialogue.text: Par app aur database dono ek hi compose file mein hain. Toh app database ko kis naam se dhoondhe?

pause.prompt: The app and Postgres are services in one docker-compose file. Which host should the app use?

dialogue.speaker: jack
dialogue.text: Service ke naam se. Compose ek network banata hai jahan har service ka naam hi uska address hota hai, toh host db likho.

broll.code:
services:
  app:
    environment:
      DB_HOST: db
  db:
    image: postgres:16

dialogue.speaker: oggy
dialogue.text: Aur pehli baar start karne pe phir bhi error aata hai, restart karun toh chal jaata hai. Woh kyun?

dialogue.speaker: jack
dialogue.text: App database ke ready hone se pehle hi start ho jaata hai. depends_on ke saath healthcheck lagao, ya connect pe retry karo.

script.takeaway: Inside a container, localhost is the container itself; reach other Compose services by their service name.

questions.prompt: Why did localhost fail inside the container?
choices: localhost pointed to the app container itself
questions.explanation: Each container has its own localhost; the database is reachable by its service name on the Compose network.
